description_sq:
Vila ka akses direkt me hyrje daljet e autostrades Tirane-Elbasan,element qe te krijon mundesine qe te aksesosh zonat qendore te Tiranes shume shpejt.
Kjo vile eshte ndertuar ne vitin 2022 dhe eshte projektuar me arkitekt.
Trualli me nje siperfaqe 1.640 m2 perfshin nje kopesht gjigand ne te cilin jane mbjelle rreth 100 peme,per te cilat kujdeset nje kopshtar cdo dite.
Ka dy burime uji qe mundeson furnizimin me uje te pijshem 24 ore.Parkim te mbuluar ne te cilin mund te parkohen mbi 6 automjete.
Panel diellor,termoizolim,sistem alarmi,sistem kamerash.
Vila ka nje siperfaqe ndertimore 407 m2 (Njolla e Ndertimit eshte 250 m2)
Organizimi:
1 ambient spacioz ndenje,me akses ne oborr,i ndricuar natyralisht nga te gjitha orientimet.
1 Kuzhine e vecuar
3 Tualete te ndricuara natyralisht
5 dhomat gjumi te mobiluara ne menyre moderene, te cilat kane orientim Jugor dhe perendimor
3 ballkone te medhenj,nga te cilet njeri eshte verande nga e cila akeson oborrin e gjelberuar.
Sistem kondicionimi Multsplit.
Sic duket dhe nga fotot mobilimi dhe te gjitha materialet e perdorura jane super cilesore.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Cmimi i shitjes:1.100.000 Euro
Per nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
description_en: The villa has direct access to the entrances and exits of the Tirana-Elbasan highway, an element that creates the opportunity to access the central areas of Tirana very quickly. This villa was built in 2022 and was designed by an architect. The plot with an area of ​​1,640 m2 includes a giant garden in which about 100 trees are planted, which a gardener takes care of every day. There are two water sources that enable the supply of drinking water 24 hours. Covered parking in which more than 6 vehicles can be parked. Solar panel, thermal insulation, alarm system, camera system. The villa has a building surface of 407 m2 (the building area is 250 m2) Organization: 1 spacious living room, with access to the yard, naturally lit from all directions. 1 separate kitchen 3 naturally lit toilets 5 bedrooms furnished in a modern way, which have South and West orientation 3 large balconies, one of which is a veranda from which accesses the green yard. Multsplit air conditioning system. As you can see from the photos, the furniture and all the materials used are of high quality. Has regular mortgage documentation. Selling price: 1,100,000 Euros For a visit to the property, contact us.
